sections.thesis: Treasuries rallied despite strong third-quarter growth data, partly on a lower oil price and as investors sought safety from AI risk, leaving the 10-year yield 0.1 percentage points lower at 4.94%.

sentences.text: Treasuries rallied despite strong third-quarter growth data, partly on a lower oil price and as investors sought safety from AI risk, leaving the 10-year yield 0.1 percentage points lower at 4.94%.
Headline PCE inflation rose 0.5% in September, lifting the annual rate to 3.6%, the highest since May.
Markets put December hike odds back at 80%, with January odds falling to around 35%.

sections.thesis: The dollar whipsawed around the ECB decision and ended unchanged.

sentences.text: The dollar whipsawed around the ECB decision and ended unchanged.
The ECB held rates at 2.5%, with Christine Lagarde hinting at another increase at the December 17 meeting.
She also announced she will step down on February 7, nine months early.

sections.thesis: Alphabet fell 13% after core search revenue fell short, dragging the Nasdaq down 1.4% while the S&P 500 dropped 0.3%.

sections.thesis: Brent has climbed back to around $110 despite a rebound in Gulf exports, on fears of renewed escalation and dwindling stockpiles; Goldman Sachs estimates those fears add about $27 a barrel.
